# Files served from the site root

Anything here is copied to the top of the built site rather than rendered as a
page. It exists for ownership proofs that search engines require at a fixed URL.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `*.txt` | IndexNow key. Its contents are the key itself, and its location tells Bing, Yandex, Naver, and Seznam that submissions come from someone who controls the site |
| `google*.html` | Google Search Console ownership verification for the URL prefix `https://amey-thakur.github.io/CLAUDE-CERTIFICATIONS/` |

Do not delete either file. Both services re-check them periodically, and removing
one drops the verification.
